from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,subprocess,hashlib
r=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes())
ref=sys.argv[2] # exact sealed commit; WORKTREE permitted only before seal
def digest(s):return hashlib.sha256(s.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
for f in r["Source_files"]:
 raw=Path(f["path"]).read_bytes() if ref=="WORKTREE" else subprocess.check_output(["git","show",ref+":"+f["path"]])
 assert len(raw)==f["after_bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==f["after_sha256"]
 s=raw.decode("utf-8") # no universal-newline conversion
 for c in reversed([x for x in r["seams"] if x["path"]==f["path"]]):
  assert digest(s)==c["state_after_sha256"]
  at=c["after_character_offset"]
  assert s[at:at+len(c["after"])]==c["after"]
  s=s[:at]+c["before"]+s[at+len(c["after"]):]
  assert digest(s)==c["state_before_sha256"]
 restored=s.encode("utf-8")
 old=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",r["Source_base"]+":"+f["path"]])
 assert restored==old==Path(f["frozen_before"]).read_bytes()
 assert len(restored)==f["before_bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(restored).hexdigest()==f["before_sha256"]
 print(f["path"]+" EXACT "+f["before_sha256"])
